scope.population: 2480267 taker fills; between-wallet share computed at every fill floor in [50, 100], per coin, per coin with the top 10 wallets by notional dropped, and pooled, at each of ['mo10_mid', 'mo60_mid']
scope.window: the ten-day window carried by quickwin_markouts_mid.npz; this file re-marks nothing and cuts no halves, so it has no window of its own

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

settings_fingerprint.overrides_note: n_perm 2000 is settings.N_PERM: the floor is 0.000500 and every p in this file sits on it, which now clears both this file's own corrected rank-one threshold (0.05/20 = 0.0025) and the 48-cell cross-month one (0.00104); rank_floor_fills (50, 100) not the declared single 50, the pair being settings.PERSISTENCE_FLOOR_FILLS applied over the WHOLE ranking window here rather than per half; no bootstrap is drawn, so n_boot does not apply; whales are dropped by NOTIONAL; the seed is settings.MASTER_SEED unchanged; both the headline and the companion window are scored, and the post-fill re-mark re-bases the companion leg at t+1s; the permutation tolerance is an ABSOLUTE 1e-12 passed to stats.permutation_p, not that module's default, which is relative to the scale of the comparison

object: OWN-SIZE CONTROL - per-counterparty markout dispersion vs a size/sign/side control. SUPPORTED CLAIM (narrow): trade size, sign and taker side do NOT LINEARLY explain the per-counterparty markout cross-section (own-size R^2 ~ 0.0003), and the identity dispersion is statistically distinguishable from a size-bucket null (size-matched placebo p <= 1/(N_PERM+1)). This is NOT a structural exclusion of own-size/style as a confound.

caveats.linear_retain_is_tautological: The linear own-size R^2 ~ 0.0003, so share_retained_fraction (~0.99) is a TAUTOLOGY of the near-zero R^2 (residualizing on ~0 explained variance cannot move the markout) and carries NO evidentiary weight. Do not cite it as exclusion.
caveats.between_share_is_in_sample: between_share_* and share_retained_* are computed IN-SAMPLE (per-wallet means reused in numerator and denominator) and carry a ~1/K upward noise floor (between_share_in_sample_noise_floor). They are descriptive, not a clean effect size.
caveats.load_bearing_evidence: Significance rests on (1) the permutation nulls - observed residual share clears both the plain-label null (label_perm_p_residual) and the SIZE-MATCHED placebo (size_matched_placebo_p), which BOTH land exactly on the 0.000500 floor: that says no draw beat the observed share and not how small the p is - and (2) the OUT-OF-SAMPLE leave-one-out per-taker R^2 (loo_taker_r2_size_residual 0.092 to 0.097 on BTC at the headline window), NOT the retain ratio.
caveats.what_the_budget_changed: Every p here is floored, and was floored at the earlier 200-draw budget too, because the observed share sits outside the null range entirely. What moved is the floor's VALUE, from 0.004975 to 0.000500, and with it what a single cell may claim. A lone significant cell must clear alpha/m unaided: 0.05/20 = 0.0025 for this file's own family and 0.05/48 = 0.00104 for the cross-month family the declared budget is sized for. The old floor sat ABOVE both, so no cell here could have been asserted on its own however strong the effect. Note what this does NOT change: the BH verdict was already reject-all at 200 draws, because 20 p-values tied at one floor clear the step-up procedure at the largest rank. That homogeneity was the budget's, not the data's.
caveats.nonlinear_control_added: A NON-LINEAR control (size + signed-size deciles, size^2, size x side) reaches R^2 of 0.005 to 0.016 at the headline window, which is 20 to 60 times the linear fit; the share still retains 0.79 to 0.93 of the raw share on that residual (share_retained_nonlinear) - that retain IS non-tautological.

scope.size_definition: size(coin units) = notional / entry_px; signed_size = sign_taker * size; sign_taker=+1 if taker bought (taker_side==1) else -1
scope.p_floor_note: 2000 draws cannot express a p below 0.000500; each cell carries label_perm_p_residual_is_floor, size_matched_placebo_p_is_floor and postfill_label_perm_p_is_floor saying which of its p-values are measurements and which are that floor
scope.reuses: i2_walletfe / i3_depth_control between-wallet share; i3_nonrecoverability_oos BH-FDR + whale-drop; i4_midmarkout pre-joined mid markouts (no-lookahead inherited)
scope.question: Do trade size, sign and taker side LINEARLY explain the per-counterparty markout cross-section, and is the between-wallet dispersion distinguishable from a size-bucket null? (Answered: no to the first, yes to the second.) The earlier 'structural exclusion' framing is retracted - see caveats.linear_retain_is_tautological.

placebos.size_matched: permute the markout WITHIN size deciles - the between share must beat a null that preserves the size<->markout link but breaks wallet identity.
placebos.postfill_remark: re-base the markout to t+1s (mo60_mid - mo1_mid): a mechanical own-impact artifact does NOT persist post-fill, genuine information does.

scope.verdict_rule: identity_beats_size_null = size-residualized between share > 0 AND beats its plain label null (p<=0.05) AND beats its SIZE-MATCHED null (p<=0.05) AND the NON-LINEAR retain (share_retained_nonlinear, the non-tautological one) holds >= 50% of the raw share. This asserts only that identity survives the LINEAR control and beats the size-bucket placebo - NOT structural exclusion of the style confound.

ols_own_size.note: R^2 of own signed size, |size| and taker side on the raw mid markout. This LINEAR fit explains essentially no markout variance (R^2 ~ 0.0003), so a high share_retained on the linear residual is a TAUTOLOGY of the near-zero R^2 (residualizing on ~0 variance cannot move the markout) and is NOT evidence. The supported claim is the narrow one: size/sign/side do not LINEARLY explain the per-counterparty markout cross-section.

ols_own_size_nonlinear.note: R^2 of a NON-LINEAR own-size control (size + signed-size deciles, size^2, size x side) on the raw markout. Much larger than the linear R^2, so the retain ratio on THIS residual (reported per cell as share_retained_nonlinear) is a non-tautological statement that identity dispersion survives a real size control.

postfill_remark.definition: post-fill markout = (mo60_mid - mo1_mid): mid move from t+1s to t+60s, both measured off the entry mid, so it re-bases the markout a few seconds AFTER the fill. A mechanical own-impact artifact does NOT persist post-fill; genuine information does.

label_perm_residual.method: permutation p = (draws at least as extreme + 1) / (usable draws + 1); the observed labelling counts as one draw of its own null, so p is floored at 1/(usable + 1) and is never zero

size_matched_placebo.method: permutation p = (draws at least as extreme + 1) / (usable draws + 1); the observed labelling counts as one draw of its own null, so p is floored at 1/(usable + 1) and is never zero

postfill_label_perm.method: permutation p = (draws at least as extreme + 1) / (usable draws + 1); the observed labelling counts as one draw of its own null, so p is floored at 1/(usable + 1) and is never zero

cells.disclosure: between_share_* and share_retained_* are IN-SAMPLE with a ~1/K noise floor (between_share_in_sample_noise_floor); the linear retain (~0.99) is a tautology of the ~0 linear R^2. Load-bearing evidence = the permutation nulls (label_perm_p_residual, size_matched_placebo_p) and the OUT-OF-SAMPLE leave-one-out per-taker R^2 (loo_taker_r2_size_residual), NOT the retain ratio. share_retained_nonlinear is the non-tautological retain.

cells.disclosure: between_share_* and share_retained_* are IN-SAMPLE with a ~1/K noise floor (between_share_in_sample_noise_floor); the linear retain (~0.99) is a tautology of the ~0 linear R^2. Load-bearing evidence = the permutation nulls (label_perm_p_residual, size_matched_placebo_p) and the OUT-OF-SAMPLE leave-one-out per-taker R^2 (loo_taker_r2_size_residual), NOT the retain ratio. share_retained_nonlinear is the non-tautological retain.

ols_own_size.note: R^2 of own signed size, |size| and taker side on the raw mid markout. This LINEAR fit explains essentially no markout variance (R^2 ~ 0.0003), so a high share_retained on the linear residual is a TAUTOLOGY of the near-zero R^2 (residualizing on ~0 variance cannot move the markout) and is NOT evidence. The supported claim is the narrow one: size/sign/side do not LINEARLY explain the per-counterparty markout cross-section.

ols_own_size_nonlinear.note: R^2 of a NON-LINEAR own-size control (size + signed-size deciles, size^2, size x side) on the raw markout. Much larger than the linear R^2, so the retain ratio on THIS residual (reported per cell as share_retained_nonlinear) is a non-tautological statement that identity dispersion survives a real size control.

postfill_remark.definition: post-fill markout = (mo60_mid - mo1_mid): mid move from t+1s to t+60s, both measured off the entry mid, so it re-bases the markout a few seconds AFTER the fill. A mechanical own-impact artifact does NOT persist post-fill; genuine information does.

_fdr.method: sort ascending, q_(i) = p_(i) * m / i, running minimum from the largest p downward, clipped to 1; NaN p-values are carried through and excluded from the family size
_fdr.family: label_perm_p_residual across every coin x horizon x K cell (per-coin, no-whale and pooled)
_fdr.threshold_meaning: the p-value cutoff actually applied: the largest rank k with p_(k) <= k*alpha/m, times alpha/m. With no rejection it is the rank-one bar the best cell failed
_fdr.q_note: the q-values are on the cells, under label_perm_p_residual_bh_q; this block holds the procedure, the family and the cutoff applied to them
